title: Refall, a free falling-block puzzle game with 60+ music-driven universes
author: Greg_war
selftext:
Refall is a free, open-source falling-block puzzle game where the music drives everything. The fall speeds up and the scene transforms on each song's drops. It has 60+ visual universes and a 15-stage campaign, and on desktop any YouTube playlist can become the levels.

I built it with Claude Code (C++ / OpenGL). Every visual is a procedural shader written by Claude: no generated images or music. The game can render its own screenshots and clips, so Claude checks its work visually. I often run several agents in parallel on separate branches.

* Web: [https://gregwar.com/refall/](https://gregwar.com/refall/)
* Binaries: [https://github.com/gregwar/refall/releases](https://github.com/gregwar/refall/releases)
* Run with uv: `uvx refall`
